Browser wait strategy 'selector' waits for specific CSS selector before considering page loaded

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\",\"wait\":\"selector\",\"wait_selector\":\"#content\"}}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
print(result)
```
